college timing: College timings are from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday.
library: The college library is open from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM.
canteen: The college canteen serves breakfast, lunch and snacks from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM.
admission: For admission, visit the Admission Office or the official college website.
placement: The Placement Cell conducts training sessions and campus recruitment drives every year.
principal: Please visit the college website or administration office for the latest principal information.
hostel: Separate hostel facilities are available for boys and girls.
fee: Please contact the Accounts Office or check the official website for the latest fee structure.
